title: Zoom - Service Degradation Affecting Zoom Phone and Contact Center Audio in US Region
text:
Service: Zoom
Incident: Service Degradation Affecting Zoom Phone and Contact Center Audio in US Region
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2026-09-03T06:42:21.225-07:00
Resolved: 2026-09-03T07:00:48.307-07:00
Updates:
- 2026-09-03T07:00:48.307-07:00: resolved - This incident has been resolved and the affected services have been restored.
- 2026-09-03T06:42:21.317-07:00: monitoring - On September 03, between 12:02 UTC to 12:17 UTC, subset of users might have experienced Zoom Phone and Contact Center audio degradation in US region. The issue has been successfully resolved. 

Our team will continue to monitor the situation closely and keep you informed of any further developments.
